responsibility: Registers the x86-specific RTL passes that the backend injects into GCC’s pass pipeline. This pass-definition fragment places target passes such as vzeroupper insertion, scalar-to-vector transformation, ENDBR/patchable-area insertion, and partial-AVX-dependency cleanup relative to generic reload, combine, cse2, and shorten-branches passes, so it defines where x86-only optimizations and hardening cleanups run in the backend pass schedule.
